title: Bacpac release notes (the release-notes.json asset, release-notes/v1)
description: The machine-readable twin of a bacpac release's body (Foundry #1604, owner ruling distribution-release-notes-1604): what changed against the previous release of the same line (the previous blank database for databases/blank/<dw>, the previous release of the same edition for editions/<edition>/<version>), what a consumer must do, and the provenance of the file. Generated by tools/ci/ReleaseNotes.ps1 from this repository's records at two commits and attached to the release by tools/ci/print-release-tags.ps1 -Execute; never hand-written. Read it with GET /repos/justdynamics/Truvio.Commerce.Distribution/releases and the asset named release-notes.json. A from of null means the previous release did not record the value, or there is no previous release.

repository.description: owner/name of the repository that publishes the release.

edition.description: The edition name; null for a blank database.

version.description: The DW version of a blank database, the edition release version of an edition database.

firstOfLine.description: true when the line has no previous release: previous is null and every from is null.

recordsCommit.description: The commit the previous release's records were read at.
The commit this release's records were read at: an edition's distributionCommit, a blank's tag commit.

dw.description: The DW version the database was created (blank) or delivered (edition) at.

swift.description: The Swift release the Distribution was proven on (gateProven.swiftVersion).

layers.description: The layers the edition composes, by the edition file's pins. Empty for a blank database.

changelog.description: The entries of the layer's CHANGELOG.md above from, up to to. Empty when the layer has no changelog or did not change.

summary.description: The first paragraph, on one line, at most 320 characters.

components.description: versions/spine.json components.<id>.current.version at the two commits, without dw and swift (stated in dw and swift).

pullRequests.description: The pull requests merged on the first-parent line between previous.recordsCommit and recordsCommit, newest first. Empty for a first release.

consumerActions.description: What a consumer must do to take this release, in order. Derived from the deltas.

provenance.description: The register entry (layers/INDEX.json bacpacs) the release was published from.

gateRunId.description: The gate run on the database restored from the file.

provenRunId.description: The run that proved the edition version; null for a blank database.

provingHost.description: The host of the edition's proof run (gateProven.releases.<edition>.host).

provedWith.description: Blank database: which edition the restore proof delivered, and where.

startsFrom.description: Edition database: the blank bacpac the delivery started from.

change.description: first: the line has no previous release.
